column1: # Indonesia, Kemenag: the printed imsak (12 Nov 2026, before the Ramadan 1448 release, spec §7, O11), kept apart from
# id-kemenag.tsv while another lane changes Kemenag's files. myQuran's republication of bimasislam.kemenag.go.id prints an
# imsak beside each Subuh that the monitor's kemenag.py does not keep; archive/code/imsak/imsak_tables.py reads it back from
# the raw answers already held (no new fetch) into archive/tables/imsak/id-kemenag/<capture>/<kota>-<year>.txt, two columns,
# the printed Subuh (equal on every day to the gated tables' Fajr in id-kemenag.tsv) and the imsak. It is Subuh - 10 on all
# 18,277 days held; the app shows the dawn less 10 (Kemenag.kt), checked here as Im, an end: never after the printed imsak.
# Rows: 2026 for the five kota of the round of 29 Sep 2026 (the whole year), the other thirteen's September-October (capture of
# 28 Sep 2026) and November-December (capture of 1 Nov 2026), whose January-August answers were never kept raw; 2027 (capture of
# 5 Oct 2026) and 2028 (capture of 11 Oct 2026) for all eighteen. Each at its kab/kota's unit, as id-kemenag.tsv. These rows read
# ends alone, so they add no place-day (the gate counts a day by a row reading a start) and must fall on days id-kemenag.tsv
# holds; each takes the split of id-kemenag.tsv's row for the same year (2026 and 2027 fit, 2028 held out), so the imsak's
